slots.GIFT_BODY: Her blood pressure on her wrist — on your phone, wherever you are.

1a.title: 1 in 3
1a.caption: One in three Nigerian adults is living with high blood pressure, and plenty of us have never once checked. A number you can see is a number you can take to your doctor. Leiko measures it on your wrist in thirty seconds — a real cuff, a real number. leiko.health

1b.title: You'll feel it when your BP is high
1b.caption: Many people believe you can feel it when your BP is up. You cannot — which is exactly why measuring is the only way to know. Take a reading, write it down, and carry the numbers to your doctor. leiko.health

sources.name: Most people with hypertension have no symptoms

1c.title: Check on Mama
1c.caption: If Mama is far from you, her blood pressure does not have to be a mystery. She wears it, presses once, and the reading shows up on your phone wherever you are. That is the whole idea. leiko.health
